lines.en: I knock on Noriko’s door and wait for her to answer.
I already know she works late most nights, so I won’t be surprised if she’s out.
But, since my luck always seems to be at least mildly good, I think the chances of us being able to spend some time alone together tonight are pretty solid.
: Come in!
And so it appears that my mildly good luck prevails once more.
I push open the door to find that the typically fruity smell of the room has vanished.
Today it’s something more like...laundry detergent.
: Oh. You’re naked.
: Mostly naked. I’m in my underwear.
: I can see that.
: Is that okay?
: Very okay. I’m just a little surprised.
: Good surprised or bad surprised?
: I think the “very” okay implies that it’s a good surprise.
: Cool. Yeah.
: That’s cool.
: You’re nervous, aren’t you?
: Yes. But I lasted three whole sentences without letting it show, so...
: Besides...all of my clothes are in the wash. So I guess we’re just gonna have to deal with this until they’re done.
: I think people normally save at least one pair so they don’t have to walk back to their room half-naked.
: We’re all girls in here. I don’t really care if they see me like this.
: Besides, Uta walks around the dorm without pants on all the time. This much is totally normal.
: And I obviously don’t care if you see me like this, too.
: Yeah. You’ve been pretty up front about your feelings for me so far.
: Is that bad?
: Why would it be bad?
: I don’t want you to think it’s bad.
: I get that, but why would it be bad?
: I don’t know. It’s not though, is it?
: Are you feeling okay?
: I feel great. Really.
: Do you want me to come back when you’re wearing more clothes?
: No! Definitely not! Please stay!
: It’s totally fine!
: Would it make you more comfortable if I took my clothes off as well?
: I don’t know.
: Okay, I’m going to take a wild guess at what’s going on here.
: Your clothes aren’t in the wash at all. You stripped down to try and impress me because you want to set yourself apart from the other girls.
: Normally, I’d try and take advantage of this situation.
: But I have this thing where my morals come crawling back once a girl’s expression starts looking like that.
: Like what?
: Like you’re about to do something you don’t want to do.
: So you don’t...
: You don’t want to have sex with me?
: Did you think I’d see you in your underwear and immediately be like, “Okay. Time to have sex?”
: I don’t know what I thought. But I clearly thought something because-
: Actually...let me try and rationalize it like this.
: Have you ever done something that you subconsciously think you want to do in hopes that certain things fall into place and just force it to happen naturally?
: I think I’m going to need an example. That was confusing.
: Like, maybe leaving the door unlocked while having “personal” time because you secretly want to get caught.
: But then you “do” get caught, and you’re just embarrassed and don’t want to carry through with your original plan anymore.
: Okay. So, a revision to my initial assessment then-
: You did put all of your clothes in the wash because you thought there was a chance I might visit you tonight.
: But now that I’ve visited you, you wish you hadn’t.
: Right?
: Your words, not mine.
: They were basically your words.
: Yeah, this is definitely not how this scenario played out in my head.
: So you do want me to leave then?
: Kind of, yes. Kind of, no.
: I kind of just want you to want me.
: Of course I want you. You’re adorable.
: And your underwear looks incredibly expensive.
: I may or may not have put on my “nice” pair in preparation for my failed attempt at seducing you tonight.
: Like I said, I can’t really seduce a girl who looks like she’s about to cry.
: So if neither one of us is going to seduce the other one, what now?
: Wanna play my ukulele?
: I feel like that would somehow make this scenario even more uncomfortable.
: Unless that’s a euphemism. In that case, please don’t turn me on any more than you already have.
: I’m already maxed out in terms of self-restraint.
: Did you...get hard for me...Sensei?
: Okay, now I’m getting mixed signals. Those are the eyes of a girl who definitely wants me to proceed.
: God, I’m so confused.
: Like yeah I clearly bit off more than I could chew here, but this could also be the perfect chance to make you mine for good.
: You think just doing something sexual is enough to make me yours for good?
: Mhm~
: Cause if there is anyone out there willing to do literally anything you want, it’s me.
: Big claim for someone who doesn’t want to do anything.
: I kind of want to, but I kind of don’t want to.
: Yeah, see, that’s a thing I need a definitive answer to beforehand.
: I forced someone into doing something they didn’t want once before, and it still kind of haunts me.
: I know. I’m the worst.
: Who are you talking about?
: I’m obviously not going to say that.
: Things have gotten a little better between the two of us since then, but I still do feel bad about it.
: The worst part is that I don’t even remember doing it. It’s like it just happened.
: You...
: Just to clarify before you misunderstand anymore, it was only a kiss.
: Oh, what the fuck! Open with that next time!
: You were making it sound like you were a full on [rapist]!
: I’m not. But that doesn’t really make what I did any better.
: So if the two of us are ever going to actually go anywhere further than me standing in your room and staring at your underwear, I need to know you’re fully on board.
: Then...h-how about we start with something small?
: How small, exactly? I’m not great at “small.”
: How about...
: We get on the bed...
: Uh-huh...
: And I lay down on top of you...
: This doesn’t sound very small.
: And I rest my head on your lap and ask you some...personal questions?
: What sort of questions are you talking about, exactly?
: Just some stuff I’m curious about. Preferences...kinks...
: And maybe some wholesome stuff like how much you like kissing.
: I mean...it’s becoming harder to conceal my erection the longer we stand here-
: Yeah...It is very much not concealed.
: I figured.
: But yeah, if you’re fine with laying on me despite wearing virtually nothing, feel free.
: I can’t guarantee you’ll like my answers to any of your questions, though.
: If I don’t like them, I will learn to like them.
: I’m going to be your dream girl whether you like it or not.
: Even if I have to tie everyone else up and throw them into a well.
Noriko swings around and gets onto her bed, patting a spot beside her for me to come sit.
I don’t think I’m fond of the prospect of her tying up my entire class, but at this point, I think she’s 90%% talk and 10%% actual action.
If anyone is going to be tied up around here, chances are they’ll be asking for it.
: Are you still okay with this?
: It’s kind of like a dream come true.
: I mean, in the dream, I didn’t have to angle my arms so they don’t come into contact with your erection, but it’s still a dream.
: You have strange dreams.
: Yeah. They run in the family.
: So, question one. How do you feel right now? Besides turned on.
: Are you happy with things like this?
: Or would you prefer we just sit straight up on the bed and never touch each other while we’re not being intimate?
: Things like this are fine. I feel good.
: Also, your skin is extremely soft.
: Cuddling, check. Moisturizer, check. I’m batting a thousand already.
: Question two. Giving or receiving?
: In which context? Because it dramatically influences my answer.
: Like, in general. Would you rather please or be pleased?
: I think anyone that says they would rather please is a liar.
: Looks like I have to prove somebody wrong.
: I’ve never been happier to disagree with someone before.
: You’re not like, opposed to pleasing though, are you?
: I know what you’re saying, but I’d appreciate if you could be a little more specific.
: How about I paint you a picture?
: It’s ten years from now and we’re in the backseat of a limo coming back from one of Nee-chan’s concerts.
: I’ve been drinking, and you know from experience that I can get really horny when I drink.
: I’m wearing a low cut dress...one that would make it really easy for you to play with me if you wanted to.
: I wrap my arms around your neck and start nibbling on your ear.
: You can tell I want it...really badly.
: Do you finger me right then and there? Or do you wait until we get home and have sex with me instead?
: The only correct answer in this scenario is both of those things.
: So you’d finger me in the backseat of a limo?
: I see no problem with this.
: What if it was a taxi or an Uber?
: I see more of a problem with this, but I’d probably still do it anyway.
: But we could get in lots of trouble.
: If I was in the driver’s position, I’d understand.
: Me too. I’m fine with watching people have sex.
: Except for Kirin and me, apparently.
: Do you want to fuck Kirin in front of me, Sensei?
: I plead the fifth.
: Pleading the fifth means not incriminating yourself in something when you’re not personally the object of investigation.
: You’re being directly questioned right now, so you can’t plead the fifth.
: It’s annoying how smart you are sometimes.
: I’ll let you fuck Kirin in front of me if I get to fuck you in front of her.
: I’m pretty sure all three of us are on the same page then.
: But, if that’s the case, why did you stop us before?
: Because she made me mad. Of course I was going to try and make her stop.
: But if you two actually kept going, what would I even do? Pull her off of you and risk breaking your penis?
: Or join in.
: No~
: I want my first sexual experience to be all alone with you.
: But some of the ones after that can involve Kirin too if you want. I bet she’s a freak.
: I’m honestly a little surprised at how okay you are with this.
: Why?
: I feel like most people who claim to be in love with someone despise the idea of that person being with someone else.
: As long as you love me, I think I’d be okay with it.
: Expecting someone to not want to have sex with someone they find attractive is unrealistic.
: Of course, there's always a chance I'd hate it once we actually try. But I’m open to trying.
: Eventually. Not now, of course.
: Yeah, that’s become very apparent tonight.
: Perverted and prudish at the same time. Noriko Nakayama.
: Being nervous doesn’t make you a prude. You didn’t even kick me out of the room.
: Perverted and embarrassed doesn’t have the same ring to it. It’s missing alliteration.
: Yeah, I guess you’re right about that.
: Any other questions for me? I actually kind of like this.
: Just one more.
: Bring it on.
: Are you in love with anyone right now?
: And I’m not talking about any residual love for Nee-chan that might still be in there somewhere.
: I’m talking about all of the girls in the class.
: Is there any one girl you look at and think about spending the rest of your life with?
: And, follow up question, what are my chances of becoming that girl?
: I’m not in love with anyone right now.
: In fact, I’ve pretty much accepted that I never will be.
: Not even if you find one person who’s perfect for you in every way?
: Who lets you sleep with other girls and will do anything you ask of her?
: Who will outlive you and never see someone else even after you die?
: Who you’ve known for your entire life?
: You’re really campaigning hard for this role, aren’t you?
: Mhm~
: I was born for it.
: And I’ll definitely make it happen someday.
: I swear.
I never answer that last question.
Which is a little strange, now that I think about it.
What would be preventing me from falling in love with someone who would be perfect for me in every sense of the word?
Who would let me sleep with other girls.
Who will outlive me and stay loyal long after I’m gone.
Who I’ve known forever.
What stands in the way of me and all of those things?
And why is it so wide that I can’t even find an edge to peer around it?
Noriko’s affection has increased to [noriko_love]!
